hero.h1: 3D scanning and CAD modeling in San Clemente
hero.sub: You have a part and no drawings. We measure it, model it, and hand you geometry you can manufacture from — with the tolerance in writing.

proof.label: part envelope, plus LiDAR for rooms and vessels

problems.title: What people come to us with
items: A discontinued part that has to be remade, with no drawings and no supplier.
A boat fitting that corroded away and needs a replacement that actually fits.
A restoration piece where the only reference is the broken original.
A supplier's first article that has to be proven against the CAD before a run.
A building with drawings that no longer match what is actually there.

steps.d: What the object is, what you need it for, what tolerance actually matters. Fifteen minutes, no charge.
Itemized by phase, with deliverable formats, units, coordinate origin and contracted tolerance spelled out. Valid 30 days.
In our San Clemente shop, or on your site. Coverage is verified before we leave.
Mesh or parametric CAD, whichever you contracted. One revision round included.
Independently checked against the spec: units, origin, tolerance, watertightness, format. You get a delivery note stating measured accuracy and any inferred geometry.

items.d: Scanner brochures quote single-scan accuracy. Real parts need many scans aligned together, and error accumulates. We quote the volumetric figure, which is the one that governs your part.

items.t: Units, origin and orientation agreed up front
items.d: The three most common causes of a rejected model, and all three are avoidable by writing them down before anyone starts modeling.
Where a surface was occluded, worn away, or assumed symmetric, the delivery note says so. You should never find that out downstream.
